s: Platform Development and Progress in Immuno-oncology 18 Platform Development and Progress in Auto-immune and inflammation 19 Autoimmune Disease For applications in autoimmune, or AI, diseases, our strategy has focused on two broad themes of antigen-specific modulation and pathway-specific modulation for controlling autoreactive T cell responses.

Approaches to Modulate Autoreactive T Cell Responses Antigen-specific approach: CUE-300 Immuno-STAT Framework The CUE-300 framework builds upon our antigen-specific approach for AI and has been focused on class II HLA alleles that are recognized by CD4+ T cells.
Immuno-STAT frameworks for AI disease will be designed to influence a subset of T cells known as CD4 T cells.
These in vivo data suggest that selective modulation of T cells with ISTs can be achieved for applications in AI diseases.
